response.overview: They grew up in the battlefield of Hebron, at the heart of the bloody conflict between Abraham’s two sons, between holiness and chaos. There, in the narrow streets of the City of the Patriarchs, these children tasted both the sweetness of paradise and the fires of the Second Intifada.  What happens to children who grow up in war? What kind of adults do they become? And what can their story teach us about the complex times Israel is living through in 2026?  This is the story of The Children of Hebron.
response.title: Children of Hebron
